name: SplitPageLayout
statusNote: SplitPageLayout is PageLayout with different defaults and no code of its own; it changes when PageLayout does, and shares its alpha status and its newer resizing and sidebar APIs.
summary: A full-bleed page frame: a sticky start pane edge-to-edge against the page, a line divider, and padded content, with lined header and footer. Choose it for settings and list-detail pages that fill the window; choose page-layout for a centred, width-capped page with gaps around the pane.

inputs.name: header
inputs.description: SplitPageLayout.Header: PageLayout.Header with padding normal and divider line by default.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: SplitPageLayout.Content: PageLayout.Content with width large and padding normal by default.

inputs.name: pane
inputs.description: SplitPageLayout.Pane: PageLayout.Pane with position start, sticky, padding normal and divider line by default. It takes every page-layout pane input (width, minWidth, resizable, currentWidth, onResizeEnd, widthStorageKey, offsetHeader, hidden).

inputs.name: panePosition
inputs.description: Pane side; at narrow widths start puts it above the content. Responsive.

inputs.name: paneSticky
inputs.description: The pane stays pinned at regular widths, scrolling internally.

inputs.name: paneDivider
inputs.description: Divider between pane and content; filled exists only at narrow widths. Responsive.

inputs.name: sidebar
inputs.description: SplitPageLayout.Sidebar: PageLayout.Sidebar with position start, padding normal and divider line by default.

inputs.name: footer
inputs.description: SplitPageLayout.Footer: PageLayout.Footer with padding normal and divider line by default.

anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.description: A PageLayout root with no padding.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: A padded banner with a 1px --borderColor-default line below it, edge to edge.

anatomy.name: Pane
anatomy.description: A padded, sticky side region flush with the page's start edge.

anatomy.name: Pane divider
anatomy.description: A 1px line between pane and content (vertical at regular widths, horizontal at narrow), touching both since there is no column gap.

anatomy.name: Drag handle
anatomy.description: As page-layout's, when the pane is resizable.

anatomy.name: Content
anatomy.description: The main region filling the rest of the width; its padded inner box is centred and capped at 1012px.

anatomy.name: Sidebar
anatomy.description: As page-layout's sidebar, padded and lined by default.

anatomy.name: Footer
anatomy.description: A padded contentinfo region with a 1px line above it.

variants.description: Pane flush at the start edge, content after it.
Pane flush at the end edge, content before it.

layout.text: The root is a PageLayout with containerWidth full, padding none, columnGap none and rowGap none: regions meet each other and the page edges with no gaps, separated only by their divider lines.
Header and footer default to padding normal (16px, 24px from 1012px) and a line divider; with rowGap none the divider touches the padded header or footer content.
Content defaults to width large and padding normal: it takes all width beside the pane, and its padded inner box is centred and capped at 1012px (equal to --breakpoint-large).

The pane defaults to position start, padding normal, divider line and sticky; its width, presets, resizing bounds and narrow-width stacking are page-layout's, with zero gutters, so the 1px divider sits directly between pane and content.
At regular widths the sticky pane pins at offsetHeader (default 0) from the viewport top with a maximum height of the viewport and scrolls internally.
The sidebar defaults to position start, padding normal and divider line; everything else is page-layout's sidebar.
Responsive ranges, spacing scale, divider styles and hidden rules are page-layout's: narrow below 768px (--breakpoint-medium), regular from 768px, wide from 1400px (--breakpoint-xxlarge).

states.text: As page-layout: a --bgColor-neutral-muted fill fades in over 150ms ease.
As page-layout: a --bgColor-accent-emphasis fill, no transition.

behaviour.text: Resizing, keyboard steps, double-click reset, persistence and viewport clamping are page-layout's; because the default position is the plain value start, pointer drag direction is correct unless a responsive position is passed.

accessibility.role: as page-layout: banner, main, contentinfo, region for an overflowing pane, slider for the drag handle
keyboard: As page-layout: Tab reaches the drag handle and an overflowing pane; arrows resize by 3px.
semantics: As page-layout; a sticky pane that overflows the viewport height becomes a scrollable, focusable region and needs an aria-label.

notes.text: The pane is sticky by default, so on a long page it stays pinned and scrolls on its own; a pane taller than the viewport is only fully reachable through its internal scroll.

The root's typed props are only className, but the spread after the defaults lets a caller override containerWidth, padding and the gaps; a native API should fix them to match the documented component.
With columnGap none the divider's margins are zero, so the drag handle's 2px outset overlaps the edges of the pane and content.
Sticky positioning, flex ordering, media-query ranges, pointer capture and localStorage persistence are as page-layout's web-only notes; a native build reuses that implementation with these defaults.
